Fetch raw inputs from their sources

Source: R/source.R
projr_source.Rd

Checks and fetches directories from the remotes that supply them, outside a build. Without remote, projr_source() uses the remotes selected under build.source, or else every remote registered under remotes. A label offered by more than one registered remote must be fetched with remote.

Arguments override the configured get settings for this call. Files that still match the last fetch are updated. Files changed locally since then are conflicts: an interactive session asks whether to keep or replace them, and otherwise conflict decides. Nothing changes until every selected label has been checked.

Usage

projr_source(
  label = NULL,
  remote = NULL,
  version = NULL,
  cue = NULL,
  strategy = NULL,
  inspect = NULL,
  conflict = NULL
)

Arguments

label

Character. Directory labels to fetch. Defaults to each source's selection, which is every declared raw directory unless build.source lists content.

remote

Character. A remote registered under remotes, named by its title or as <type>:<title> when the title is used by both types.

version

Character. "latest", a major version ("1"), a minor version ("1.2"), an exact build ("1.2.3"), or "current" to restore the inputs recorded for this checkout's completed build (see projr_restore()). Defaults to the configured version, or "latest".

cue

Character. "if-change" (the default here), "always", "if-empty" or "never".

strategy

Character. "sync-diff", "sync-purge", "download-all" or "download-missing".

inspect

Character. "manifest", "file" or "none".

conflict

Character. "error", "local" (keep changed local files) or "remote" (replace them).

Value

Invisibly returns TRUE.

See also

projr_restore(), projr_get_local(), projr_get_github()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
projr_source()
projr_source("raw-survey", remote = "github:survey-team", version = "0.6")
projr_source(conflict = "remote")
} # }
